# Incident response

Internal runbook for an actively exploited vulnerability in a shipped product.

1. Within 24 hours of becoming aware, the on-call lead files the early warning
   with the national CSIRT and with ENISA through the Single Reporting Platform.
2. Within 72 hours, the vulnerability notification follows, with the corrective
   and mitigating measures applied so far.
3. Within 14 days, the final report goes out.

This runbook covers the regulatory clock only. The customer communication plan
is separate.
